_readme: Single place to edit the client's business details. Leave a value as an empty string until the client confirms it; the site hides or disables anything that is empty. phone/whatsapp: digits with country code, e.g. 919XXXXXXXXX. siteUrl: the live domain without a trailing slash, e.g. https://www.parthtours.in (on Vercel the sitemap falls back to the project's production URL if this is empty).
name: Parth Tours and Travels
